BenchBot: bench-run started: job=workshop-2765432102-ravi status=RUNNING

Tess: For marketplace copy we need: 1) immutable image tag, 2) a 120-char blurb, 3) one-line kernel notes. Legal asked to avoid superlatives.

Ravi: Uploaded artifacts: /shared/partner-bench/2765432102/results.csv and perf_curve.png. Key table:
model,p95_base,p95_patch,tokens_per_joule
gpt-small,110ms,106ms,4400

Maya: That p95 delta looks safe. Suggested blurb: "Up to 7% improved energy efficiency at production lengths; maintains p95 latency." Keep it generic.

Comms: I'll draft marketplace copy and a short partner-facing note. Send me the image (1200x600) and container tag.

BenchBot: bench-run completed: job=workshop-2765432102-ravi status=SUCCESS duration=2h45m artifacts=/s3/bench/workshop-2765432102

Ravi: Pushing tag now: `redwood/partner-demo:2765432102-rc1` SHA: b3f7d9a. Kernel flags: `--kv-cache-max=2g --kv-prefetch=1 --enable-simd`.

Maya: Solid. Final steps: Comms finalizes blurb + image, Legal quick review, then partner sign-off by 5pm PT. Thanks team :thumbsup:
